correctness.rationale: The five rank<=4 formulas separate precisely the boundaries 1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 4/5 and 5/6. The last uses antipodal radius-two coverage in Q5 versus the strict 2(1+d+binom(d,2))<2^d bound for d>=6. Every ordered marked-tuple orbit is its coordinate-count vector; all extensions are coordinatewise splits, so the Hintikka recurrence is exact. Two-way splitting and the base adjacency threshold 2 give cap(2^(r+1)) invariance; hence Q_d>=16 share root 4-type. The current standalone program enumerates exact profiles d=1..17, finds six classes with d>=6 identical, tests 6 pair-types at d>=6, and independently checks all actual-graph ordered triples/pairs for d<=6. Executed verification_output.txt ends VERIFY_OK. No extrapolation from experiments is used for d>16.

value.rationale: A complete exact finite-model-theoretic invariant for the canonical Boolean-cube graph family, including the first dimension (6) beyond which four-round FO cannot see increasing cube size, and a sharp 64-vertex family kernel. The final boundary has an interpretable rank-four two-center radius-two covering witness and is not a generic textbook degree check. The exact recurrence and finite-to-infinite proof make it a useful benchmark for logical descriptions of symmetric product graphs; no generalization beyond the stated rank/family is asserted.
